description.en: Multiplied by the density instead of dividing by it, so a denser material appeared to give a thicker film from the same mass.
description.et: Korrutas tihedusega, selle asemel et sellega jagada, mistõttu tundus, nagu annaks tihedam aine samast massist paksema kile.

description.en: Divided the mass by the density alone, giving the volume of deposited material rather than its thickness on the substrate.
description.et: Jagas massi ainult tihedusega, mis annab sadestunud aine ruumala, mitte kile paksuse alusel.

description.en: Put the area in the numerator and the mass in the denominator, inverting how each affects the result.
description.et: Pani pindala lugejasse ja massi nimetajasse, pöörates ümber mõlema mõju tulemusele.
